hypotheses.title: Domestic Operating Income Margin Convexity in Broad Market Neutrality
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Domestic operating profit (fnd2_ebitdm) reflects core domestic earnings power insulated from foreign currency translation adjustments and geopolitical disruptions. Applying industry-relative cross-sectional ranking with quadratic decile weighting in broad TOP3000 market neutrality isolates top-quintile domestic profit compounders while neutralizing systematic market beta.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns decay to Sharpe < 0.8 during domestic consumer demand expansion.

hypotheses.title: Discretionary Free Cash Flow Yield Elevation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Subtracting capital expenditures from Funds from Operations (fnd6_fopo - capex) yields true discretionary free cash flow. Companies with abundant organic free cash flow possess internal financing autonomy, superior pricing power, and capacity for debt retirement or share buybacks, driving sustained risk-adjusted alpha in broad market neutrality.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Negative performance during corporate earnings announcement cycles.

hypotheses.title: Accelerating Multi-Factor Fundamental Surface Momentum
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The first derivative of the multi-factor pentagon style score (fscore_bfl_surface_accel) captures firms experiencing simultaneous inflection points across profitability, earnings quality, and operational momentum. By targeting fundamental acceleration rather than static levels, the signal eliminates stagnant value traps and front-runs institutional portfolio rebalancing.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Performance degrades to Sharpe < 0.8 during economic cycle inflection points.
